name: blackthorn
first_pickup_chronicle: Blackthorn. The shillelagh wood. Irish farmers carried it for two centuries against landlords and worse. The grain is so dense it rings like iron when you strike it.
design_notes: Band A heavy wood. Mult 1.15, weight 1.25, enchant 1. The wood-class equivalent of pig_iron. Fills Band A wood-heavy gap.
